sentences.text: Google Cloud's incident persists in our region, us-central1.
Customer login and API use remain unreliable since 17:51 UTC.
Staff use Cloudflare Access, whose authentication is failing.
Google applied mitigations; Cloudflare services are starting to recover.
Evidence conflicts: Google's support account denies disruptions; its status page confirms them.
Root cause, recovery time and Workers KV data-loss status remain unknown.
We're throttling retries and preparing request replay [R-16][R-14].
Naming decision settled: provider unnamed in live updates [R-12].
We'll update at 20:15 [R-17].
Google Cloud's incident still affects us-central1, Northwind's only region; Firestore and Firebase Auth calls return 503.
Cloudflare's outage affects Access, used for staff internal tools; services are starting to recover.
Google applied mitigations without disclosing its identified cause.
Root cause, Northwind recovery time, and whether Workers KV lost data remain unknown.
